nelson-7.name: Founders Heritage Park
nelson-7.bio: Relocated historic buildings with mini-museums, a bakery, a brewery cafe and a weekend heritage railway.
notes: Adult $12.10 rounded to $12; locals free with ID. Weekend railway timetable not checked; visit time 3-5 h is a judgement.

nelson-8.name: Melrose House
nelson-8.bio: An 1879 Victorian house with a cafe and free gardens, its lawns looking past the cathedral tower to Tasman Bay.
notes: Closed Mondays and public holidays per the operator (contact page also says open 6 days). Free per Wikivoyage (council-owned).

nelson-9.name: Nelson Provincial Museum
nelson-9.bio: The regional museum on Trafalgar Street, telling Nelson and Tasman's history from geological origins to family stories.
notes: Held for a photo. Adult $7 is the non-resident Regional Gallery admission; free for Nelson Tasman residents; temporary exhibitions may cost extra. Hours are weekday hours; weekends and public holidays close at 4:30 PM.

nelson-10.name: Natureland
nelson-10.bio: A conservation-charity zoo at Tāhunanui Beach Reserve with meerkat and lemur encounters and keeper talks.
notes: No English Wikipedia article: wiki omitted. Adult $21 (operator); Wikivoyage $12 is out of date. Day of the closure (364 days a year) not stated.
Held for a photo.

nelson-11.name: Isel House and Park
nelson-11.bio: An 1849 house in 4 ha of park, with Victorian furnishings and some of New Zealand's oldest exotic trees.
nelson-11.hours: Park open 24 hours; house 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM Tue–Sun, mid-Oct to end-Apr
notes: Admission by donation per council text (via Kotuia); council page is BLOCKED so no ticketUrl. House open Tue-Sun mid-Oct to end-Apr, generally 11am-4pm; Wikivoyage says Tue-Sat; hours vary by season and volunteers. No English Wikipedia article: wiki omitted.

nelson-12.name: Boulder Bank
nelson-12.bio: A natural spit of boulders, walked 8 km to The Cut, with an 1862 cast-iron lighthouse near its end.
notes: Pin moved from the far-end lighthouse to the Boulder Bank Drive trailhead (-41.21629,173.32906); exact start of the path at the road end is unconfirmed.
Expert unformed route; dogs prohibited on the western 4 km 15 Aug to end Feb (not in bio).

nelson-13.name: Mapua
nelson-13.bio: A small town whose wharf has cafes, a smokehouse and fish and chips overlooking the Waimea Estuary.
notes: Held for a photo. Pin moved to Mapua Wharf (-41.25651,173.10194). Open 24 hours is public access to the wharf, not the shops. Name written without macron; wiki is the article title.

nelson-14.name: Great Taste Trail
nelson-14.bio: A 200 km Great Ride cycle trail, two-thirds off-road, ridden as a short section or over several days.
notes: Pin moved to Rutherford Park, the official site's Nelson CBD start (-41.26849,173.28024). Site states no fee but not 'free'; ferry and bike hire cost extra.

abel-tasman-8.name: Marahau
abel-tasman-8.bio: The village at the park's southern entrance, where tramping, kayaking and water taxi trips start.
notes: Held for a photo. No ticketUrl (no single steward). Pin moved to the OSM village node. Name written without macron; wiki is the article title.

abel-tasman-9.name: Wainui Falls
abel-tasman-9.bio: A 20 m waterfall with a summer swimming pool, reached by a one-hour return DOC track from Wainui Bay.
notes: Pin kept at the falls (within 100 m of OSM); the car park is 1.3 km away at -40.83877,172.94013.

abel-tasman-10.name: Abel Tasman Inland Track
abel-tasman-10.bio: A 41 km, three-day advanced tramping track from Marahau to Wainui Bay through the park's interior.
notes: Held for a photo. Pin moved to Pigeon Saddle where the track meets the Takaka-Totaranui road (-40.83261,172.96865); the Wikipedia point was mid-track. Hut fees not checked; free covers walking only.

abel-tasman-11.name: Awaroa Inlet
abel-tasman-11.bio: A remote inlet and beach in the park, known as the People's Beach after a 2016 crowdfunded purchase.
notes: Held for a photo. Pin moved to Awaroa Hut by the beach (-40.86526,173.01757). Crossing is tide-dependent (tide tables on DOC's Coast Track pages, not checked), hence 'Tides permitting'. ticketUrl is DOC's Awaroa campsite page.

abel-tasman-12.name: Apple Tree Bay
abel-tasman-12.bio: A beachside bay on the Coast Track where water taxis stop, with a DOC campsite of 15 tent sites.
notes: Held for a photo. No English article: wiki omitted. Pin is the beachside DOC campsite. ticketUrl is DOC's campsite page; Great Walk campsite bookings required.

golden-bay-7.name: Cape Farewell
golden-bay-7.bio: The South Island's most northerly point, seen from a lookout five minutes' walk from the car park.
notes: Pin moved to the OSM viewpoint near the car park (-40.50025,172.69783). Car park not separately confirmed.

golden-bay-8.name: Puponga Farm Park
golden-bay-8.bio: A free DOC farm park whose 8 km hilltop walk passes Pillar Point Lighthouse and Cape Farewell.
notes: No English article for the farm park: wiki omitted. Pin is the Port Pūponga settlement node; the exact car park point for the Hilltop Walk was not found.

golden-bay-9.name: Rawhiti Cave
golden-bay-9.bio: One of New Zealand's largest cave entrances, about 40 m wide, reached by a steep track to a viewing platform.
notes: Expert route through private property to an informal car park (not in bio). Pin is the cave entrance, about an hour's climb from the car park.

golden-bay-10.name: Ligar Bay
golden-bay-10.bio: A sheltered Golden Bay beach with mudflats and rockpools at low tide, beside the Abel Tasman Monument.
notes: Pin moved to the village node (-40.8223,172.90948). No ticketUrl (public beach).

golden-bay-11.name: Abel Tasman Monument
golden-bay-11.bio: A 1942 sail-shaped concrete monument to Abel Tasman's 1642 visit, on a rock outcrop above Golden Bay.
notes: Bio omits the walk time (not in research); either OSM point acceptable.

golden-bay-12.name: Collingwood
golden-bay-12.bio: Golden Bay's northern town, with a museum and cafes, and the departure point for Farewell Spit tours.
notes: Held for a photo. Collingwood Museum open daily 9am-6pm by donation (Wikivoyage).

golden-bay-13.name: Tata Beach
golden-bay-13.bio: A Golden Bay beach and holiday settlement about 1 km south of the uninhabited Tata Islands.
notes: No ticketUrl (public beach).

golden-bay-14.name: Ngārua Caves
golden-bay-14.bio: Limestone caves on Takaka Hill, visited on hourly guided tours, with a moa skeleton display.
notes: Tours hourly 10am-4pm, daily in summer; off-season hours and tour length not stated (1-1.5 h is a judgement). Adult $30.

nelson-lakes-4.name: Travers-Sabine Circuit
nelson-lakes-4.bio: A five-to-six day circuit through Nelson Lakes National Park, ending at the Mount Robert car park.
notes: Held for a photo. Pin moved to Nelson Lakes Visitor Centre, St Arnaud (-41.80475,172.84377). Hut fees not checked.

nelson-lakes-5.name: St Arnaud Range Track
nelson-lakes-5.bio: A 10 km return track up the St Arnaud Range from Kerr Bay, taking about five hours.
notes: Held for a photo. Pin moved to the guidepost on the east of Kerr Bay (-41.80676,172.84735); exact trailhead sign not confirmed.

nelson-lakes-6.name: Rainbow Ski Area
nelson-lakes-6.bio: A club ski field near St Arnaud, open mainly at weekends in winter, with intermediate-focused slopes.
notes: Held for a photo. Season dates change yearly; adult lift day pass $130 (non-member 18-64). Mountain is in Marlborough District. Hours given as a season qualifier.

kahurangi-4.name: Wangapeka Track
kahurangi-4.bio: A 59 km tramping track crossing two saddles over 1,000 m, taking four to six days one way.
notes: Pin moved to Siberia Flat Campsite at the Tasman-end start (-41.44212,172.58402); Rolling River car park coordinates not found. Hut fees not checked.

kahurangi-5.name: Mount Arthur
kahurangi-5.bio: A 1,795 m peak in Kahurangi National Park, a 9.2 km one-way climb from Flora car park.
notes: Pin moved to Flora car park (-41.19028,172.74711). Flora car park road is steep unsealed Graham Valley Road, 4WD recommended (not in bio). Visit time derived from DOC one-way time.

kahurangi-6.name: Cobb Valley
kahurangi-6.bio: A valley reached by a 28 km road to Cobb Reservoir, the highest hydro storage lake in New Zealand.
notes: No English article 'Cobb Valley': wiki omitted (only Cobb Reservoir exists). Pin is Cobb Dam Visitor Centre.

nelson-4.name: Nelson Classic Car Museum
nelson-4.bio: More than 150 classic cars, from a 1903 Cadillac to Jaguars and Ferraris, in the former World of WearableArt building.
notes: Adult $20; closed Christmas Day. Old wowcars.co.nz is dead. Little Engine Eatery cafe left out of the bio for length.

golden-bay-2.bio: A beach of dunes, caves and the Archway Islands, where fur seal pups play in the rock pools at low tide.

notes: Skipped by instruction: motueka-1 and murchison-1 (proposed destinations).
Maruia Falls wiki 'Maruia River' is a broader article: omitted when the spot is added.
needs_owner: none left unpriced; Isel House is donation-based so free:true with no ticketUrl (council page blocked).
Lake Rotoiti/Rotoroa wiki titles per research; abel-tasman-7 Totaranui research says already accurate, no coordinate change.
